blind_spots: a Pfam domain is a statement about a family that has been curated, so the inside arm is biased towards well-studied protein families and the outside arm towards everything else. The direction is fixed and cannot be removed by a control here

identity over a short envelope is quantised, so no percentage is reported below 20 columns and every figure carries its column count
